notes.title: Criminal Girls: Invite Only Now Available! FAQ
notes.content:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/CG_Main.jpg[/img]
Hey there doods, I'm happy to announce that [i]Criminal Girls: Invite Only[/i] on Steam is now live! I want to give a special shout out to all our beta testers that helped make it happen!

I'm aware that there are many questions surrounding this release in particular, and I wanted to go over a few things just to make absolutely certain that our customers and fans know what they're getting and hear it from us directly:

[list]
    [*][b]Is the game censored?[/b] The Steam version is an identical port of the localized PlayStation Vita release of the game. All edits (including to the artwork) present in that version will be present in this version.
    [*][b]Will there be an uncensor patch?[/b] Not officially, no. But if fans wanted to make a patch or otherwise modify game files, that is fine. That will not be prohibited. 
    [*][b]What's the status of [i]Criminal Girls 2[/i]?[/b] Still looking into it! NISA (and NIS, of course) has a very busy lineup this year. 
[/list]

Thank you for reading! If you're curious about the thinking that goes into these kinds of decisions, more can be found on our [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/blog/CG2/][i]Criminal Girls 2[/i] blog post[/url]. And if anyone has any trouble with their game, please post in the Troubleshooting forums! I will also be in the game's group chat for a little bit today, so hop in to ask me any questions! 

Welcome to Hell, doods!
Alex
